coverage.note: Neither repeated asset rows, market-quarter cells nor source-record counts establish independent events.

design.augmented: same baseline plus log1p(reconstructed proxy CAD / 1e9)
design.baseline: ridge AR with intercept and lagged BCPI YoY
design.feature_scaling: training-only mean and population standard deviation; intercept unpenalized
design.fold_unit: all markets and assets in a target quarter stay together
design.information_set: training outcomes end at target minus information lag; all predictors use their target minus information lag
design.vintage_boundary: latest-vintage retrospective pseudo-out-of-sample; publication-time vintages unavailable; not a real-time forecast test

historical_comparison.interpretation: Reconstruction/model difference on reused test quarters, not an AI effect or independent validation.

limitations: All arms reuse the same observed outcomes and fold definitions. Prior v0.1 results were known before this follow-up protocol.
Source ablation is a diagnostic comparison, not a measured contribution to construction costs.
Current dollar components occupy different markets. Project-only and permit-only results must not be added as independent effects.
Existing annual schedule and realization assumptions remain unvalidated. Full-schedule arithmetic does not establish actual timing.
No arm is automatically selected or promoted, even if point-error thresholds pass.
protocol_boundary: Follow-up to the unsuccessful v0.1 benchmark; same test quarters reused, so this is not a fresh confirmatory holdout. No settings selected after v0.2 results.

scope.price_basis: dimensionless change in the source BCPI index; no CAD translation

selection_policy: report every predeclared arm and subgroup; no automatic winner selection or model promotion
